Job Posting: 178589 - Position: S26 Data Analyst Co-op 178589 Co-op Work Term Posted: 2026 - Summer App Deadline Application Method: Posting Goes Live: Job Posting Status: 03/03/2026 09:00 AM Through UBC Science Co-op 02/24/2026 04:37 PM Approved ORGANIZATION INFORMATION Organization Address Line 1 City ICBC Insurance Corporation of British Columbia 151 Esplanade W North Vancouver Postal Code / Zip Code V7M3H9 Province / State Country British Columbia Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Work Mode Salary Currency Salary Job Description 2026 - Summer S26 Data Analyst Co-op 178589 Co-op Position North Vancouver Canada 4 or 8 months Hybrid CAD 26.86 per hour for 37.5 Major List *Please fill out the Co-op questionnaire as a part of your application* About ICBC ICBC is one of BC's largest corporations and one of Canada's largest property and casualty (P&C) insurers with annual earned premiums of $6.0 billion and $17.5 billion in assets. We are driven to ensuring the well-being of drivers while working to keep rates low, delivering excellent service consistently, and proactively partnering to reduce crashes. We are a dynamic and forward-thinking organization dedicated to leveraging data-driven insights to fuel our business strategies and decisions. ICBC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Are you: • Passionate about data • Curious about trends, patterns and outliers • Creative visualizing data • A self-starter who is motivated and ready to learn! Position Highlights We are looking for an analytical and highly motivated individual to join our Business Analytics team as a Data Analyst on a co-op term. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with insurance data and building visualizations in a collaborative and innovative environment. You will utilize your querying skills and data visualization techniques to support our business operations partners and play a crucial role within our analytics team. Your ability to translate business requirements into data requirements and ultimately into business insights will support informed data driven decision-making across the organization. What We Offer • Hands-on experience in a real-world business analytics environment. • Mentorship from experienced data professionals. • Opportunity to work on meaningful projects that impact business decisions. • A supportive and inclusive workplace culture. • Networking opportunities with professionals across the organization. This position resides out of the North Vancouver head office and includes a hybrid work model. Salary: $26.86 per hour + 11.2% in lieu of vacation and stats Job Requirements Qualifications • Currently pursuing a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field. • Proficiency in SQL with experience in querying databases. • Basic knowledge of data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar). • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to accuracy and quality. • Position Requirements • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from various databases. • Develop and maintain basic data visualizations and dashboards to communicate insights effectively to stakeholders. • Collaborate with business units to understand their data needs and translate these into clear data requirements. • Assist in the preparation of reports and presentations that summarize findings and recommendations. • Support ad-hoc data analysis requests to drive business improvements and strategic initiatives. • Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas for improving data processes and methodologies.
